critical_code_review_comments: media_library.py uses a module-level cached `_storage_key` with no thread/process-safety — under multi-worker uvicorn each worker re-inits independently which is fine, but a 403 retry path mutates the global from a request handler without a lock. Low risk given current single-worker deployment but worth noting.

marketing_campaigns.py PATCH endpoint accepts a free-form `dict` body (no Pydantic model) — relies solely on the `allowed` whitelist; consider migrating to a CampaignUpdate model for OpenAPI documentation completeness.

media_library.py uses `requests` (sync) inside async FastAPI handlers — for large file uploads (≤50MB) this will block the event loop. Recommend switching to httpx.AsyncClient or running via asyncio.to_thread().

marketing_campaigns.py + media_library.py both directly use db['<collection>'] with no index hints — `marketing_campaigns.find().sort('created_at', -1)` and `media_library.find({'is_deleted': {'$ne': True}}).sort('created_at', -1)` will benefit from a `(is_deleted, created_at)` and `(status, created_at)` compound index respectively.
